task.description: Validate the design artefact at src/design/audit_chain_text_resource_id.md per the standard CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR procedure. Run `python3 tools/lint_design_artefact.py src/design/audit_chain_text_resource_id.md` and verify it exits 0 with no BLOCKER/MAJOR. Then verify the 7 hard requirements: (1) every acceptance criterion in every MUST requirement (here: ISS-0122 acceptance criteria = the 9 items in diagnosis.yaml) has a design element; (2) no implementation code is present in the artefact (no Zig function bodies, no SQL CREATE statements, only design-level descriptions and pseudo-SQL); (3) all public function signatures are listed (bpm_audit_chain_canonical_payload, bpm_audit_compute_chain_hash, bpm_audit_apply_chain_hash); (4) error taxonomy exists (22021, 22023, 42703, 42P10, others); (5) dependencies documented (pgcrypto for digest, pgcrypto is installed as part of test_infrastructure_guide — verify by listing src/design or migration files that reference pgcrypto); (6) classification per templates/lego-catalog.md is correct (Type E cross-cutting — only the audit chain subsystem + 4 migrations + 1 test file); (7) the test contract section lists exactly the TCs the diagnosis requires (TC-EE-10-06, TC-EXT-01-INT-07, TC-SCH-02-02, plus new TC-AUDIT-UTF8 with assertions a-d). On PASS set next_action='Route to BACKEND-DEV (Step 3)'. On FAIL set next_action='Route to CODE-DESIGNER for rework' and list every blocked check.

result.summary: Design artefact src/design/audit_chain_text_resource_id.md is lint-clean and covers all 8 acceptance criteria from docs/issues/ISS-0122.json / scratch/WF03-gh388-20260802/issue-fixer-step1/diagnosis.yaml. tools/lint_design_artefact.py exited 0 with BLOCKER=0 MAJOR=0. The 7-section Type E structure (module purpose / affected files / schema+migration / public interface / error taxonomy / test contract / migration safety) maps every MUST requirement to a concrete design element; the 3 failing pre-fix TCs (TC-EE-10-06, TC-EXT-01-INT-07, TC-SCH-02-02) plus the new regression TC-AUDIT-UTF8 are explicitly enumerated. No Zig function bodies or executable SQL DDL — only design-level outlines and signature blocks. No executable CREATE TABLE / CREATE FUNCTION / CREATE TRIGGER; the few matches are inside narrative prose in section 3 step 5 (migration operation outline) and section 8 Q3 (test-body comment), both explicitly labelled as design-level.
